replenishment_policy.instruction: Add new todo tasks only when the pool falls below minimum_todo_tasks. Prefer small production steps for Fathom: price reader, schema, API endpoint, tests, cache, x402, docs and deployment hardening. Never generate high/critical tasks for autonomous execution.

autonomous_loop_policy.selection_rule: Choose the first todo task that is not claimed and not high/critical risk.
autonomous_loop_policy.anti_stall_rule: Do not ask the user for the next task while safe low/medium tasks can be generated from README.md, docs, failing CI or TODO comments.
autonomous_loop_policy.failure_rule: If CI fails, prioritize a fix task before new features.

tasks.title: Bootstrap Jules/Codex governance loop
tasks.description: Add AGENTS.md, task manifest, validator, tests and bridge CLI for Fathom.

tasks.title: Document Fathom production architecture
tasks.description: Create docs/architecture.md describing API, DEX adapters, pricing engine, confidence scoring, cache, x402 payment flow and deployment assumptions.
acceptance: docs/architecture.md describes confidence scoring and cache
docs/architecture.md lists production risks and non-goals

tasks.title: Choose MVP tech stack
tasks.description: Decide between Cloudflare Workers and Vercel for the first MVP and document the tradeoffs for viem, cache and x402 integration.
acceptance: Next implementation task is updated if needed

tasks.title: Scaffold TypeScript API project
tasks.description: Create a minimal TypeScript API scaffold for Cloudflare Workers (using Wrangler/Hono) with health endpoint and test setup, without production deployment or secrets.
acceptance: No secrets or production deployment are added

tasks.title: Define Fathom price response schema
tasks.description: Create stable TypeScript types for /v1/price response including price_usd, price_low, price_high, twap, liquidity_usd, confidence, label, pools, flags and updated_at.

tasks.title: Implement confidence scoring module
tasks.description: Implement deterministic confidence scoring from liquidity, source deviation, TWAP deviation, sigma/mu and market maturity using configurable thresholds.
acceptance: Unit tests cover reliable, thin, stale and manipulation-like cases

tasks.title: Add DEX Adapter interface
tasks.description: Create a standard DEXAdapter interface to discover pools and fetch raw data for price and liquidity calculation.
acceptance: It includes getPools and getRawData methods

tasks.title: Add Aerodrome DEX Adapter
tasks.description: Implement the DEXAdapter interface for Aerodrome on Base.
acceptance: Tests verify pool discovery and raw data fetching

tasks.title: Add Uniswap V3 DEX Adapter
tasks.description: Implement the DEXAdapter interface for Uniswap V3 on Base.
acceptance: Tests verify pool discovery and raw data fetching

tasks.title: Add Uniswap V2 DEX Adapter
tasks.description: Implement the DEXAdapter interface for Uniswap V2 on Base.
acceptance: Tests verify pool discovery and raw data fetching

tasks.title: Add caching layer for price responses
tasks.description: Implement KV caching layer to reduce RPC calls and latency for repeated queries.

tasks.title: Improve Uniswap V3 Adapter Error Handling
tasks.description: Improve the error handling in the Uniswap V3 Adapter to handle rate limits and specific revert strings.
acceptance: Adapter handles RPC rate limits explicitly
Adapter handles missing pool errors specifically

tasks.title: Integrate DEX Adapters
tasks.description: Create an orchestration component that aggregates DEX adapters to discover all pools for a token and fetch the required raw data.

tasks.title: Implement price calculation logic
tasks.description: Create a service to calculate price and liquidity based on raw data fetched by DEX adapters.
acceptance: Service exists to calculate price from reserves/ticks

tasks.title: Setup x402 payment wrapper
tasks.description: Add x402 middleware to /v1/price endpoint to enforce payment via Fathom's monetization strategy before returning cached or calculated price.
acceptance: Returns HTTP 402 with correct payment instructions
Tests verify payment bypass vs block behavior

tasks.title: Implement /v1/prices batch endpoint
tasks.description: Add an endpoint that accepts a comma-separated list of tokens and returns an array of PriceResponses, utilizing the cache.
acceptance: Validates multiple tokens up to a sane limit (e.g. 10)

tasks.title: Write README for pricing engine
tasks.description: Add a small README inside src/pricing explaining the adapter architecture and confidence scoring calculations.
acceptance: README explains pricing and confidence scoring

tasks.title: Improve logging in cache layer
tasks.description: Add detailed console logs in KVCacheLayer when cache hit and cache miss occur to improve debugging.
